breakNotes.Fall Recess: Students return Monday, November 30. For students following the standard SFUSD academic calendar, the recess creates nine consecutive days without school.
breakNotes.Winter Recess: Students return Monday, January 4. For students following the standard SFUSD academic calendar, this creates 16 consecutive days without school.
breakNotes.Spring Recess: Students return Monday, April 5. For students following the standard SFUSD academic calendar, this creates 10 consecutive days without school.

calendarFaqs.q: Are all religious and community observances on the SFUSD calendar no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. SFUSD says the Academic Calendar's observance list is intended to build awareness of dates that may affect attendance. Districtwide closures and recesses are identified separately in the Academic and School Holiday calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: Which SFUSD calendar should families use?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the Academic Calendar for instructional dates, recesses, and the first and last day of instruction. Use the School Holiday Calendar for a one-page view of school closures and breaks. The Work Calendar is primarily for employee schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after SFUSD Winter Recess?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students return for spring instruction on Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after SFUSD Spring Recess?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs March 26 through April 2, 2027. Students return Monday, April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Does SFUSD have school on Lunar New Year in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: No. SFUSD identifies Friday, February 5, 2027 as Lunar New Year Observance, with school sites and Early Education Department programs closed.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: The first day moves from August 18 in 2025–26 to August 17 in 2026–27.
The last day moves from June 10 in 2025–26 to June 2 in 2026–27.
Fall Recess moves from November 24–28 in 2025–26 to November 23–27 in 2026–27.
Spring Recess moves from March 27–April 3 in 2025–26 to March 26–April 2 in 2026–27.

customSections.label: School Closures vs. Religious and Community Observances
customSections.content: SFUSD's Academic Calendar also lists major religious and community observances. Those dates are not all districtwide school closures. SFUSD describes the observance list as an awareness resource for dates that may affect attendance. On this page, “Holiday” and “No School” are reserved for dates SFUSD identifies as school closures or no-school days.

customSections.label: Which SFUSD Calendar Should I Use?
customSections.content: SFUSD publishes several calendars for different purposes. The 2026–27 Academic Calendar is available in English, Chinese, Vietnamese, Samoan, Spanish, Tagalog, and Arabic from the district calendar hub.

definitions.description: Use this for instructional dates, the first and last day of instruction, recesses, and SFUSD's list of major religious and community observances.
Use this one-page calendar when you mainly need districtwide school holidays, closures, and recesses.
This is primarily for employee workdays. A date on the Work Calendar does not automatically mean students have the day off.

customSections.label: Three-Year SFUSD Calendar History
customSections.content: Start and end dates have shifted across recent SFUSD calendars, so families should use the calendar for the specific school year they are planning.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 13, 2026 using SFUSD's current Academic, School Holiday, and Work calendars and the district's August 6 calendar announcement.
sourceReviewDetails: The July 2026 Academic Calendar confirms August 17 as the first day of fall instruction, June 2 as the last day of spring instruction, and 180 total student days split 82/98 between fall and spring.

We reviewed the complete color-coded Academic Calendar and its major religious and community observance list. SFUSD says that list is intended to increase awareness; it is not a list of districtwide school closures.
The August 2026 School Holiday Calendar separately confirms districtwide holidays, Fall Recess, Winter Recess, Spring Recess, and the January 4 and April 5 return dates.
The August 11 Work Calendar covers employee schedules. We use it to explain the official calendar system, not to infer additional student no-school days.
The July Academic PDF replaced the May 29 file previously linked on this page. No changes to the core student dates listed here were found in the newer file.
